subjects.title: Maths
subjects.framework: Common Core State Standards for Mathematics

units.title: Powers of ten
goals: Explain that each place is worth ten times the place to its right and a tenth of the place to its left
Multiply and divide by 10, 100 and 1,000, and write powers of 10 with exponents

units.title: Decimals to thousandths
goals: Read, write and compare decimals to thousandths
Round decimals to any place

units.title: Multiply whole numbers
goals: Multiply multi-digit numbers the standard way

units.title: Divide by two-digit numbers
goals: Divide numbers of up to four digits by two-digit numbers and explain the steps

units.title: Add and subtract decimals
goals: Add and subtract decimals to hundredths

units.title: Multiply and divide decimals
goals: Multiply and divide decimals to hundredths and explain where the decimal point goes

units.title: Expressions and brackets
goals: Work out expressions with brackets
Write expressions for words like "add 8 and 7, then multiply by 2"

units.title: Fractions with different denominators
goals: Add and subtract fractions and mixed numbers with different denominators
Check that an answer is reasonable with benchmark fractions

units.title: Fractions as division
goals: Explain that 3/4 means 3 divided by 4
Solve sharing stories with answers that are fractions

units.title: Multiply fractions
goals: Multiply a fraction by a fraction or by a whole number
Find the area of a rectangle with fraction sides

units.title: Multiplying as scaling
goals: Tell whether a product is bigger or smaller than a factor without multiplying

units.title: Dividing with unit fractions
goals: Divide a unit fraction by a whole number, and a whole number by a unit fraction

units.title: Percentages
goals: Read percent as "out of 100"
Change between fractions, decimals and percentages
Find a percentage of an amount (a discount in gold)

units.title: Convert units and line plots
goals: Convert between units of the same system, like cm and m
Use line plots with fractions to solve problems

units.title: Volume with cubes
goals: Measure volume by counting unit cubes
Use V = l × w × h
Add the volumes of two boxes

units.title: The coordinate grid
goals: Plot points in the first quadrant of a grid
Make patterns from two rules and graph their pairs

units.title: Shape families
goals: Sort two-dimensional shapes into a family tree by their properties

units.title: Angles in triangles and quadrilaterals
goals: Use angles on a straight line, at a point and vertically opposite
Use the angle sums of triangles (180°) and quadrilaterals (360°)

units.title: Matter is made of particles
goals: Explain that matter is made of particles too small to see

units.title: Mass is kept
goals: Show that the total weight stays the same when things change, mix or melt

units.title: Properties of materials
goals: Identify materials by their properties, like colour, hardness, magnetism and how they carry heat

units.title: Mixing and making new substances
goals: Tell when mixing two substances makes a new substance

units.title: Gravity pulls down
goals: Explain that Earth's gravity pulls things towards its centre
Compare gravity on Earth and on the Moon

units.title: Friction, air resistance and machines
goals: Explain air resistance, water resistance and friction
Show how levers, pulleys and gears let a small force do big work

units.title: Electric systems
goals: Build series and parallel circuits
Draw circuits with symbols
Use electricity safely

units.title: Energy from the Sun in food
goals: Explain that the energy in food was once energy from the Sun

units.title: Plants grow from air and water
goals: Explain that plants get what they need to grow mainly from air and water

units.title: How living things reproduce
standards: SG P5 reproduction in plants and animals
goals: Explain pollination, seeds and spores
Compare the life cycles of mammals, amphibians, insects and birds

units.title: Breathing and the heart
standards: SG P5 respiratory and circulatory systems
goals: Explain how lungs take in oxygen
Explain how the heart and blood carry oxygen and food around the body

units.title: Food webs
goals: Model how matter moves among plants, animals, decomposers and the environment

units.title: Earth's spheres
goals: Describe how land, water, air and living things affect each other

units.title: Water on Earth
goals: Show how much of Earth's water is salt water, fresh water and ice

units.title: Protecting Earth
goals: Find out how communities protect Earth's resources and environment

units.title: The Sun and other stars
goals: Explain that the Sun looks brighter than other stars because it is much closer

units.title: Shadows, days and seasons
goals: Explain patterns of shadows, day and night, and the stars we see in each season

units.title: Quote to prove it
goals: Quote a text accurately to explain what it says
Back up an inference with a quote

units.title: Themes and comparing characters
goals: Find a story's theme and summarise the story
Compare two characters, settings or events

units.title: The narrator's point of view
goals: Describe how a narrator's point of view shapes how events are told

units.title: Figurative language
goals: Explain similes and metaphors in a text

units.title: Main ideas and how they connect
goals: Find two or more main ideas of a text
Explain how people, events or ideas in a text are connected

units.title: Comparing text structures
goals: Compare how two texts are organised
Compare two accounts of the same event

units.title: Many sources, one answer
goals: Find an answer using several texts
Pull facts together to explain a topic

units.title: Idioms, sayings and proverbs
goals: Explain common idioms, sayings and proverbs

units.title: Words with two meanings
goals: Use synonyms, antonyms and homographs to understand each word better

units.title: Greek and Latin roots
goals: Use Greek and Latin roots like photo, graph and auto to work out meanings

units.title: Perfect tenses
goals: Use had walked, have walked and will have walked
Keep the verb tenses in a text consistent

units.title: Conjunctions, prepositions and interjections
goals: Explain what conjunctions, prepositions and interjections do
Use either/or and neither/nor

units.title: Commas
goals: Use commas in lists, after an opening word or phrase, with yes and no, and to speak to someone

units.title: Titles of works
goals: Show titles of books, songs and poems with underlining, italics or quotation marks

units.title: Write an opinion piece
goals: Order reasons logically and back them with facts
Link ideas (consequently, specifically)
Also: formal and informal language (UK Y6)

units.title: Write to explain
goals: Write an information text with headings, definitions, facts and quotations

units.title: Story techniques
goals: Use dialogue, description and pacing
Show how characters respond to events

units.title: Speak and present
goals: Present a report clearly with facts at a steady pace
Summarise what a speaker said

subjects.title: History
subjects.framework: England's National Curriculum (KS2-KS3) with California world history, Cambridge Humanities and C3

units.title: Ancient Greece: daily life
goals: Compare Athens and Sparta
Describe homes, school and the Olympic Games

units.title: Greek ideas that last
standards: UK KS2 (influence on the western world)
goals: Explain democracy in Athens
Describe Greek theatre, maths and thinkers

units.title: The Persian Empire
goals: Describe its roads, its royal post and its many peoples

units.title: Rome: from republic to empire
goals: Explain how Rome grew and how it was ruled

units.title: Life in Roman times
goals: Describe towns, roads, baths and the army
Find Latin words we still use

units.title: The Romans in Britain
standards: UK KS2 (the Roman Empire and its impact on Britain)
goals: Describe Hadrian's Wall and Boudica's revolt
Say what the Romans left behind

units.title: Ancient India
goals: Describe the Maurya Empire and Ashoka
Explain how Indian mathematicians gave us zero and our digits

units.title: Han China and the Silk Road
goals: Describe Han inventions such as paper
Explain how the Silk Road carried goods and ideas

units.title: The Maya
goals: Describe Maya cities, calendars, writing and number system with zero (around AD 900)

units.title: What the ancient world gave us
standards: UK KS2 (legacy of Greek or Roman culture)
goals: Compare Greek, Roman, Indian and Chinese ideas we still use

subjects.title: Geography
subjects.framework: England's National Curriculum (KS2-KS3) with Cambridge Humanities and C3

units.title: Latitude and longitude
goals: Find places by latitude and longitude
Find the Tropics and the polar circles

units.title: Time zones
goals: Explain why it is day in one place and night in another
Use the Prime (Greenwich) Meridian

units.title: Climate zones
goals: Locate polar, temperate, tropical and desert climates
Explain why they differ

units.title: Biomes of the world
goals: Describe rainforest, desert, grassland, tundra and forest and what lives there

units.title: Rainforests
goals: Describe the layers of a rainforest
Explain why rainforests matter

units.title: Deserts and polar lands
goals: Explain how people, animals and plants live in extreme places

units.title: Natural resources
goals: Find where water, wood, metals and fuels come from
Tell renewable from non-renewable

units.title: Trade around the world
goals: Explain how goods travel between places and why places trade

units.title: Atlases and digital maps
goals: Use an atlas index
Read a digital map and a satellite image

units.title: The Alps and the Andes
standards: UK KS2 place knowledge (European and American regions)
goals: Compare two mountain regions: land, weather, work and towns

subjects.title: Citizenship
subjects.framework: England's citizenship, C3 civics and economics, Jump$tart, Japan's and Finland's ethics

units.title: What is democracy?
goals: Explain rule by the people
Describe voting and elections, then and now

units.title: Laws
goals: Explain why we have laws
Say who makes laws and who makes sure they are kept
Know that laws differ between countries

units.title: Fair and just
goals: Choose fair consequences
Listen to both sides before deciding

units.title: News and opinions
goals: Tell news from opinion
See that a story can have different sides

units.title: Many cultures, one community
goals: Respect different cultures, beliefs and ways of life
Find what we share

units.title: Courage and doing the right thing
goals: Stand up for what is right, safely
Ask for help when it is too big

units.title: Make a budget
goals: Plan money coming in and going out
Put needs first, then saving, then wants

units.title: Banks and interest
goals: Explain what banks do
Show how interest makes savings grow

units.title: Borrowing and paying back
goals: Explain that borrowing usually costs money (interest)
Only borrow what you can pay back

units.title: Caring for the planet together
goals: Plan a class action for the environment
Measure what changed

units.title: Big questions: what do we owe each other?
goals: Discuss sharing, fairness and duty with reasons
Listen and build on others' ideas

subjects.title: Computing
subjects.framework: England's computing with CSTA, Cambridge Computing and Digital Literacy, Estonia and Korea

units.title: Variables at work
goals: Use variables that change as a program runs (score, lives, level)

units.title: Loops inside loops
goals: Use a loop inside a loop to draw patterns

units.title: Procedures
goals: Name a group of steps and use it again

units.title: Simulate it
standards: UK KS2 (controlling or simulating physical systems)
goals: Program a simple simulation (a bouncing ball, a growing plant)

units.title: Remix and give credit
goals: Change someone's program and give them credit

units.title: How messages travel
goals: Explain that information is split into packets with addresses

units.title: How search engines rank
standards: UK KS2 (how results are selected and ranked)
goals: Explain why some results come first
Spot adverts in results

units.title: Real or edited?
goals: Spot edited pictures and misleading posts

units.title: Spreadsheets
goals: Enter data
Use a sum formula
Make a chart

units.title: People you meet online
goals: Know that people online may not be who they say
Never share where you live
Tell an adult

units.title: Technology for everyone
goals: Describe how technology helps people with different needs (captions, read-aloud, big text)

subjects.title: Art and Design
subjects.framework: England's Art and Design with the National Core Arts Standards and Cambridge

units.title: One-point perspective
goals: Draw a road or a room that goes into the distance

units.title: Greek and Roman art
goals: Describe columns, mosaics, statues and pottery

units.title: Mosaics
goals: Make a mosaic from small tiles (blocks)

units.title: Architecture
goals: Explain how buildings are designed
Describe famous buildings from around the world

units.title: Still life
goals: Arrange objects and draw them with light and shade

units.title: Abstract art
goals: Make art from shapes and colours only (Kandinsky, Mondrian)

units.title: Textile art
goals: Weave and dye a pattern

units.title: Illustration and comics
goals: Tell a story in panels with pictures and words

units.title: Develop an idea
goals: Look back through a sketchbook, pick an idea and develop it

subjects.title: Music
subjects.framework: England's Music with the National Core Arts Standards

units.title: Major and minor
goals: Hear the difference between major and minor
Play a major scale

units.title: Chords
goals: Build a chord from three notes
Play a simple chord pattern

units.title: How songs are built
goals: Find verse, chorus, bridge
Recognise ABA and rondo

units.title: Write a song
goals: Fit words to a melody
Write a catchy chorus

units.title: Great composers
standards: UK KS2 (great composers, history of music)
goals: Describe Bach, Handel, Haydn and Mozart and the music of their time

units.title: Rhythms of the world
goals: Play patterns from West African drumming, samba and gamelan

units.title: Reading melodies
goals: Read a melody on the stave with its rhythm

units.title: Playing together
goals: Keep together in a group
Follow a conductor

units.title: Music technology
goals: Record, loop, layer and edit music (a step grid and tracks)

subjects.title: Health and PE
subjects.framework: England's PE and health education, SHAPE America, the National Health Education Standards and CASEL

units.title: Net and wall games
goals: Serve, rally and place the ball

units.title: Tactics
goals: Use space, positions and roles to play well as a team

units.title: Create a dance
goals: Choreograph a short dance with a group

units.title: Personal best
goals: Measure your fitness
Set a goal and a plan to improve

units.title: Liking yourself
goals: Explain self-esteem
Use kind self-talk
Know every body is different

units.title: Changing friendships
goals: Tell healthy from unhealthy friendships
Handle peer pressure

units.title: Medicines and harmful substances
standards: RSHE drugs, alcohol, tobacco and vaping
goals: Use medicines only as a trusted adult says
Know the facts about tobacco, vaping and alcohol and how to say no

units.title: Allergies and illness
goals: Name common allergies
Know how to stay well and when to get help

units.title: Sleep and screens
goals: Explain how screens before bed affect sleep
Know how much sleep you need

units.title: Emergency first aid
goals: Check for danger, check the person, call for help
Know what choking looks like and to get an adult

units.title: Orienteering
standards: UK KS2 outdoor and adventurous activity
goals: Follow a map and compass course

subjects.title: Design and Technology
subjects.framework: England's Design and Technology with Finland's, Estonia's and Japan's crafts and home economics

units.title: Gears and pulleys
goals: Build a machine with gears or pulleys that changes speed or direction

units.title: Cams and moving toys
goals: Make a moving toy with a cam

units.title: Bridges
goals: Compare beam, arch and truss bridges
Test a bridge for strength

units.title: Design on screen
goals: Plan a build with a computer drawing (a blueprint)

units.title: Control it with code
standards: UK KS2 (computing to program and control products)
goals: Program a model to move or light up

units.title: Seasonal cooking
goals: Cook a savoury dish with seasonal ingredients

units.title: Reuse and redesign
goals: Make something useful from waste materials

units.title: Fabrics and clothes
goals: Tell natural from made fibres
Explain spinning and weaving

units.title: Test and review a product
goals: Test a product against its criteria
Suggest improvements

subjects.title: Projects
subjects.framework: Finland's modules, Japan's integrated study, the IB and Cambridge Global Perspectives

units.title: A Roman town
standards: IB PYP How we organise ourselves
goals: Build a Roman town on a grid (roads, baths, forum) and give its buildings coordinates

units.title: A biome expedition
goals: Visit three biomes in the game's worlds, record food webs and weather, write an expedition report

units.title: A fair on a budget
goals: Plan a village fair with a gold budget, prices, discounts and posters
